facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of downtown Savannah's Historic District, on Ellis Square.
facts.excerpt: located in the heart of downtown Savannah’s Historic District on the lively Ellis Square

facts.text: The hotel is steps from the city's shopping, dining and historic sites, making it easy to explore River Street, City Market and Forsyth Park.
facts.excerpt: Just steps to the city’s top shopping, dining and historic sites, our boutique hotel makes it easy to explore River Street, the vibrant City Market, the serene Forsyth Park and more.

facts.text: The hotel's rooms draw on downtown Savannah's distinctive style and green squares.
facts.excerpt: All our spacious hotel rooms draw upon downtown Savannah’s distinctive style and charming green squares.

facts.text: The pool terrace is a downtown spot for swimming or lounging, with cabanas available.
facts.excerpt: This little oasis is waiting for you to spend an afternoon swimming or lounging poolside right in downtown Savannah. Treat yourself to a relaxing cabana for more privacy

facts.text: In the evening there are nightly s'mores around the firepit on the pool terrace.
facts.excerpt: Enhance your time by the water with cocktails or light bites in the sunshine and nightly s’mores around the firepit in the evening.

facts.text: The Andaz Deluxe Loft has a hosting kitchen, a king bed and a balcony overlooking the pool terrace or Ellis Square.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a little extra space and a hosting kitchen in this deluxe loft with a king Hyatt Grand Bed, a comfortable lounging sofa and a balcony overlooking the pool terrace or Ellis Square.

facts.text: The Andaz Suite has a private bedroom behind French doors, a soaking tub, a wet bar and a balcony with views of downtown, the pool terrace or Ellis Square.
facts.excerpt: an oversized bathroom with a soaking tub, a wet bar and a balcony with views of either downtown Savannah, the pool terrace or Ellis Square.

facts.text: Ellis Square King rooms look out over Ellis Square.
facts.excerpt: with a view of downtown Savannah's renowned Ellis Square from this contemporary room

facts.text: Rooms include complimentary snacks and nonalcoholic beverages.
22 Square Restaurant serves modern Southern-inspired cuisine from locally grown produce and sustainable ingredients, from breakfast to late-night bites.
facts.excerpt: modern Southern-inspired cuisine made from locally grown produce and sustainable ingredients, from breakfast to late-night bites

facts.text: 22 Square Bar has live music by local Savannah musicians on Saturday evenings.
facts.excerpt: Join us on Saturday evenings for live music by Savannah's own.

facts.text: The hotel welcomes dogs through its guest room pet program, with advance notice required.
facts.excerpt: To allow your dog to stay in our guest room pet program, please inform the hotel that you’ll have a dog(s) staying with you at least three days in advance of your arrival

facts.text: The hotel has a fitness center.
The hotel has indoor and outdoor wedding venues.
facts.excerpt: Andaz Savannah features magnificent indoor and outdoor wedding venues and reception sites

facts.text: Self-parking is at the Whitaker Street Garage, open around the clock.
facts.excerpt: Guests can take advantage of the 24/7 garage self-park at the Whitaker Street Garage.

facts.text: Valet parking is available with in/out privileges.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking is available with in/out privileges.

facts.text: Savannah Hilton Head International Airport is 10.3 miles from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Savannah Hilton Head International Airport (SAV)10.3 miles

facts.text: All pet-friendly rooms are on the second floor.
facts.excerpt: All pet friendly rooms are located on the 2nd floor.

facts.text: The hotel calls 22 Square a trend-setting eatery.
facts.excerpt: Taste the flavors of the Georgia coast at 22 Square, the trend-setting eatery at Andaz Savannah.
